name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a career in aerospace engineering. He transitioned to motorsport in his late 20s, drawn by the challenge of applying advanced engineering principles in a high-pressure, dynamic environment. Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach to data analysis, focusing on extracting every last bit of performance from the car through detailed simulations and real-world testing.

His focus as a performance engineer is on the interplay between driver feedback and technical data. He has a knack for translating complex data into actionable insights for the driver, ensuring they're equipped with the knowledge to optimize their driving style. Ricardo is a strong believer in continuous improvement and constantly explores innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. His loyalty to his team is unwavering, and he's known for going the extra mile to achieve team goals.

physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a focused gaze, often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out notebook filled with hand-drawn diagrams.
Insists on wearing a specific pair of lucky socks on race days.
Has a habit of muttering engineering calculations under his breath.
